Solara — (9.4) QUASAR

CREW'S CONTROL

"Crew's control"

[Verse 1]

She said: we leave at first light

Lara said: may I formally request to join this crew

She said: yes

Lara said: I will need to get my notes

She said: bring everything you have

Lara left

Lara came back the next morning

With three hundred bags

Three hundred

She said: I said everything

[Pre-Chorus]

Aldric was already at the door

He had seventeen maps unrolled on the floor

He said: I have been ready since the council meeting

He said: I knew what she was going to say

The crew was assembling

The way crews assemble

With a lot of noise

And someone already eating

[Chorus]

Crew’s control

We are the lowest ranked in every room we have ever entered

Crew’s control

We have no business going where we are going

But the stars are calling

And the captain answered

And nobody told us we couldn’t

Crew’s control

Lowest in the ranking

Highest in the going

We leave at first light

We leave at first light

[Verse 2]

Then the door opened

Nobody had knocked

Nobody had invited

He was already packed

He was very large

And very old

And had four legs

And a very large pot

He said: I am Crotus

He said: I will be joining

He said: the journey will be long

He said: and you will need sustenance

Everyone looked at him

He looked back

Persy said: did anyone ask him

Rion said: no

Persy said: okay

Rion said: okay

Crotus set his pot down

The floor made a sound

[Pre-Chorus 2]

SOLARA looked at the crew

Persy — confidence without evidence, already standing like he had won something

Rion — already holding something, nobody knew what

Cygnus — one small step toward the door

Herc — lion hide on, ready since before the meeting

Cassie — not explaining herself, never needed to

Castor — first knight, hands at his sides

Aldric — undead, seventeen maps, been ready since the council

Lara — youngest seraphim, three hundred bags, still writing

Crotus — centaur, old and wise, uninvited and already packed

She said: alright

[Bridge]

This was not an army

This was not a fleet

This was not a force that anyone would look at

And feel afraid

This was a crew that went to negative forty-five

And came back

A crew that fought a hollow

And sealed it

A crew that lost a captain

And found her again

At a bar

Near a south star

With a raven on her hand asking the right questions

This was the crew that decided

That level one hundred was not a ceiling

It was a destination

Lowest in the ranking

Highest in the going

[Final Chorus]

Crew’s control

The universe did not pick the most powerful

The universe did not pick the most decorated

The universe picked this crew

Crew’s control

A captain who carries two of the greatest to ever live

A knight who is his twin’s promise kept

A queen who never explains herself

A hunter who never missed

A hero with confidence and no evidence

A dead man with better maps than anyone living

A swan who always comes back

A laborer who remembered before he could think

A seraphim with three hundred bags and no regrets

A centaur nobody asked who came anyway

Lowest in the ranking

Highest in the going

We leave at first light

[Outro]

And they did

First light

Eleven of them

Plus seventeen maps

Plus three hundred bags

Plus one very large pot

Plus one raven

Who nobody asked either

But here she was

Walking toward Level one hundred

Walking toward whatever burned the stars

Walking toward whatever the old pact was afraid of

Crotus said: breakfast will be ready in twenty minutes

Persy said: I love this crew

Nobody disagreed

Opens warm and intimate. Builds to genuinely epic. Bridge spoken like a legend. Final chorus biggest moment on album — full ensemble, triumphant. Outro drops to crew walking, Persy’s last line in near-silence. BPM 110, major key, fades into horizon. 5:20.
